title: Fixed Split Double Hoop and Tilting Floor Stand
description: One newly authored whole empty embroidery-hoop floor stand in a fixed tilted display pose. Two long feet and a braced single upright carry a transverse shaft and complete side jaw clamp. The head contains a full inner wooden hoop and a separate truly split outer band, with real radial clearance, two metal lug blocks and a complete cross bolt across the split. Both rings and local clamp share one rigid tilt about the illustrated shaft. The entire central aperture remains empty: no cloth, stitch pattern or borrowed loom mesh. Unlike the old weaving frame this is not a rectangular two-upright warp-and-cloth rig, and unlike the old windowed tambourine this is not a single pierced shell with jingles. Four opaque constant PBR materials; metres, native Z up and full horizontal-bounds-centred ground datum. One whole prop zero scenes. Static empty craft-tool exterior only: no adjustment, clamping force, fabric tension, manufacture, ergonomic fit, bearing performance, stability or safe-use claim. No rigging, animation or interaction.
